short_cause: Tunnel negotiation failed after successful authentication
fix_summary: Update VPN client to the gateway's currently supported version; if already current check local firewall/antivirus is not blocking the tunnel's assigned port.

short_cause: Gateway certificate is untrusted or expired on the client machine
fix_summary: Reinstall the corporate root certificate bundle via the standard endpoint management push; do not have the user manually trust the cert.

short_cause: TLS handshake failure between client and gateway
fix_summary: Check client OS TLS version support; gateways deprecated TLS 1.0/1.1 support in the last major firmware update.

short_cause: IKEv2 traffic blocked by an intermediate firewall or NAT device
fix_summary: Confirm UDP 500/4500 and ESP protocol are not blocked on the user's network; common on hotel and public Wi-Fi.

short_cause: Floating license lease expired and failed to auto-renew from the license server
fix_summary: Have the user reconnect to the corporate network and relaunch the app; if it recurs check the license server's lease pool isn't exhausted.

short_cause: Two application threads are holding locks the other needs, causing a permanent freeze
fix_summary: Force-close and restart the application; if it recurs on the same workflow step, escalate with the exact step for the dev team to inspect the lock order.

short_cause: Application crashed mid-deploy due to a missing environment variable in the target environment
fix_summary: Check the target environment's config against the deployment checklist for missing/renamed environment variables before retrying the deploy.

short_cause: Client did not receive a lease response before the DHCP request timed out
fix_summary: Confirm the DHCP scope for that subnet isn't exhausted; have the user release/renew, and check the switch port's VLAN assignment if it persists.

short_cause: Two devices on the same subnet were assigned the same static or leased IP address
fix_summary: Identify the conflicting device via ARP table lookup and release/reassign one of the two IPs; do not have the user simply reboot repeatedly.

short_cause: Intermittent latency spikes correlated with a saturated uplink during peak hours
fix_summary: Check the switch's uplink utilization graphs for the affected time window before assuming a client-side issue; escalate to network engineering if uplink is saturated.

short_cause: Physical switch port entered an error-disabled state after repeated link flapping
fix_summary: Have facilities check the physical cable/connector first; if clean, the port needs to be re-enabled from the switch admin console -- do not swap the user's machine first.
